name: Apple Push Notifications
description: Send native iOS and iPadOS push notifications through Apple Push Notification service (APNs). One team-scoped connection can deliver to multiple bundle IDs and both APNs environments.

credential_fields.name: team_id
credential_fields.label: Apple Team ID
credential_fields.description: The 10-character Team ID from your Apple Developer account.

credential_fields.name: key_id
credential_fields.label: APNs Key ID
credential_fields.description: The Key ID of a key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles with APNs enabled.

credential_fields.name: private_key
credential_fields.label: APNs Private Key (.p8)
credential_fields.description: Paste the full contents of the APNs AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 file, including the BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY lines.

credential_fields.name: relay_encryption_key
credential_fields.label: Relay encryption key
credential_fields.description: Generated automatically by Apteva when the connection is created. Push uses it to encrypt APNs device tokens at rest.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send one APNs notification to a device token. Pass the complete aps dictionary and optional provider-neutral data object; APNs authentication and transport headers are added automatically.

device_token.description: The raw APNs device token returned to the native app.

topic.description: The receiving app's bundle ID, used as the APNs topic.

environment.description: The APNs environment that issued this device token.

push_type.description: APNs push type. Use alert for visible notifications and background for silent refresh.

priority.description: APNs priority. Visible alerts normally use 10; background pushes use 5.

expiration.description: Optional UNIX timestamp after which APNs may discard the notification.

collapse_id.description: Optional identifier used by APNs to replace an older equivalent notification.

data.description: Optional application data placed beside aps in the notification payload.
